content: क्षार {%a.%} [क्षर्-ज्वला बा˚ ण] .²1 Corrosive, caustic, acid, pungent, saline. .²2 Flowing, oozing. .{@-रः@} .²1 Juice, essence. .²2 Treacle, molasses. .²3 Any corrosive or acid substances; क्षते क्षारमिवासह्यं जातं तस्यैव दर्शनम् <ls>U. 4. 7</ls>; क्षारं क्षते प्रक्षिपन् <ls>Mk. 5. 18</ls>; (क्षारं क्षते क्षिप् <ab>&c.</ab> has become proverbial, and means ‘to aggravate the pain which is already unbearable’, ‘to make bad, worse’, ‘to add insult to injury’). .²4 Glass. .²5 Salt; caustic alkali; <ls>Y. 3. 36</ls>. .²6 Ashes. .²7 A rogue, cheat. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Black salt. .²2 Water. .²3 See क्षारः (3); आः क्षते क्षारमेतन्मे क्षिप्तं केनेत्यभाषत <ls>Ks. 93. 14</ls>.
